text: Professional profile Founded in 2002, the biotechnology major of Wenzhou University is a key construction major of Wenzhou University in the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan", which conforms to the national strategy of "Healthy China", is based on the frontier of life sciences, closely focuses on the development of talent needs in the biological health industry, aims to cultivate international vision, master the core basic theoretical knowledge of biotechnology and high-level professional operation skills, and can be able to study in life science research, biotechnology transformation, biosafety testing, High-level application-oriented talents in biotechnology education and food safety management.Core courses Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Organic Chemistry, Genetics, Chemical Engineering, Genetic Engineering, Bioinformatics, Fermentation Engineering, Biological Separation Engineering, Food Safety Testing, Food Safety and Quality Control, etc.
